text: This Contract enters into force on signature. The Notice to Proceed shall be issued within 21 days after the last of the following conditions precedent has been fulfilled: (a) delivery of the Performance Security and the Advance Payment Guarantee; (b) delivery of the parent company guarantees of both consortium members; (c) financial close of the Owner's project financing; and (d) the positive EIA decision remaining valid and unchallenged.
title: Effectiveness
